تعايرت (form VI)
# تَعَايَرْتُ (taʕāyartu) /ta.ʕaː.jar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَايَرَ (taʕāyara)
# تَعَايَرْتَ (taʕāyarta) /ta.ʕaː.jar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَايَرَ (taʕāyara)
# تَعَايَرْتِ (taʕāyarti) /ta.ʕaː.jar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَايَرَ (taʕāyara)
# تَعَايَرَتْ (taʕāyarat) /ta.ʕaː.ja.rat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
